scope.summary: Pinned-session queueing is deadline-accounted: a request that cannot start within its own budget returns typed SESSION_BUSY with queued_ms and a positive retry_after_ms, is audited once as a BLOCKED session_busy record and never reaches the dispatcher; a queued request with budget left runs.
out_of_scope: Fairness and throughput under contention; holder cancellation (T2.4).

entry_points.name: oracle_execute over one Streamable HTTP MCP session (W4 w4_runtime_issue50_session_busy, FREE23)
entry_points.trace: PASS: holder UPDATE observed in V$SQL blocked on a fixture lock; same-session queued write with timeout_seconds=2 returned SESSION_BUSY (HTTP 429 path) queued_ms=2000 retry_after_ms=250, one BLOCKED/FAILED session_busy audit, holder then rolled back normally and the post-release retry succeeded.

limitations: retry_after_ms is min(250 ms, profile call timeout), not the holder's remaining budget suggested by implementation note 3; the frozen acceptance only requires > 0.
issue50_second_request_gets_session_busy_not_zero_ms and issue50_session_busy_executes_nothing share one body; the pre-fix 'call timeout of 0 ms' failure was not re-run by the verifier.
Live proof is FREE23 over HTTP only (the acceptance's proof class); stdio and XE lanes were not exercised live.
